clues.label: Plot
clues.value: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker ▇▇▇ begins a new life at the ▇▇▇ prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, ▇▇▇ comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named ▇▇▇ -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
